public.text: The four options of preserving, upgrading, integrating, or retiring existing investments are useful but incomplete. Countries may also need to consolidate duplicate systems, contain systems temporarily, replace only selected capabilities, or maintain them during a prolonged transition.
public.suggestedRevision: Introduce a standard disposition framework such as retain, remediate, integrate, consolidate, re-platform, replace, retire, or tolerate temporarily. Require rationale, cost, risk, dependencies, and target date for each decision.
